texts.heroTitle: Where Little Learners Grow with Confidence
texts.heroLead: A nurturing, structured preschool experience in a warm, home-like setting where every child is known, supported, and prepared for what comes next.
texts.heroHighlight2: Now accepting children as young as 20 months if ready
texts.introKicker: Looking for a nurturing place where your child will truly learn, grow, and thrive?
texts.introTitle: Small, Structured Preschool Care With Big Heart
texts.introBody: At Cottontail Childcare & Education, we offer a small, structured preschool experience in a warm, home-like setting so every child gets the attention they deserve.
texts.programsTitle: Real Preschool Learning in a Calm, Caring Setting
texts.programsBody: Your child receives more than supervision here. Each day blends structured preschool learning, social-emotional growth, and individualized support so children build confidence while preparing for kindergarten.
texts.benefit1Body: With a maximum of 6 children, each child receives individual support, more learning time, and stronger confidence.
texts.benefit2Body: Children work on letter sounds, early reading, writing, name tracing, counting, numbers, and early math in age-appropriate ways.
texts.benefit3Body: Children thrive in calm routines, organized learning spaces, and a setting focused on safety, health, and kindness.
texts.benefit4Body: Families receive photos, learning updates, and daily highlights so they stay connected to each child's day.
texts.spaceTitle: A Bright Space for Learning and Play
texts.spaceBody: Cottontail is designed to feel calm, clean, and inviting, with room for reading, creative play, preschool activities, and small-group learning.
texts.galleryBody: From reading and preschool activities to creative play and outdoor time, these moments show the kind of warm, engaged days children enjoy here.
texts.trust1Body: Children benefit from guidance shaped by real classroom experience and a clear understanding of kindergarten readiness.
texts.trust2Body: CPR and First Aid certified, background checked, and committed to a safe, steady environment families can trust.
texts.trust3Body: As a mother of two, the care here is rooted in connection, patience, and the kind of attention every child deserves.
texts.aboutTitle: A Place Where Children Feel Safe, Loved, and Excited to Learn
texts.aboutBody1: At Cottontail Childcare & Education, we create a place where children feel safe, loved, and excited to learn. Our days are intentionally balanced so children keep growing academically, socially, and emotionally.
texts.aboutBody2: The goal is simple: every child leaves feeling more confident, more capable, and more ready for kindergarten.
texts.pricingBody: One straightforward weekly rate for families who want a small-group setting with personalized attention and real preschool learning.
texts.ctaTitle: Schedule a Tour Before Spots Fill
texts.ctaBody: We only accept 6 children. Once spots are filled, enrollment closes.
